summary: Frontend testing completed successfully for Shri Ramya eCommerce website. All 8 features verified working: Products page displays 13 products with images, all category filters work (Women Ethnic Wear + Home & Lifestyle), Homepage shows both category sections, Product detail page with price/description/variations, Virtual Try-On button appears on clothing products only, Virtual Try-On modal opens correctly with upload interface, Add to Cart functionality works.
seed_data_creation: N/A - Using existing product data in MongoDB
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features tested and working: Products page with 13 products, category filters (Sarees, Lehengas, Ladies Suits, Dupattas for Women Ethnic Wear; Bedsheets, Pillow Covers, Cushion Covers, Dohar for Home & Lifestyle), product detail page with Virtual Try-On (MOCKED - returns garment image without Replicate API token), Add to Cart with success toast.

homepage.details: Homepage loads correctly with Women Ethnic Wear and Home & Lifestyle category sections visible. Featured and Trending products grids display correctly.

products_page.details: 13 products displayed with proper images from Unsplash. All filter buttons visible and functional.

product_detail_page.details: Product name, price with discount, description, variations, fabric, craft style, origin displayed correctly. Add to Cart and Wishlist buttons visible.

virtual_tryon.details: Virtual Try-On button visible only on Women Ethnic Wear products. Modal opens correctly with Upload Photo area, Use Camera button, Try It On button, and tips section. MOCKED API - returns garment image when Replicate API token not configured.

add_to_cart.details: Add to Cart button works, shows 'Added to cart!' toast notification, cart badge updates with count.

api_health.details: API health check returns healthy status. MongoDB connected, WooCommerce disabled (using MongoDB fallback).

mocked_apis.virtual_tryon: MOCKED - Replicate API Virtual Try-On returns garment image instead of AI-processed image when REPLICATE_API_TOKEN is not configured
